headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.8731). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 32 studies yielded an effect size of 1.05 (95% CI: 0.66–1.68), indicating no statistically significant association between dehydroepiandrosterone and uterine cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 99.03%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
